name: 087.2 — every ending returns the receiver
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 087.2: sub:off(), timer:cancel(), widget:destroy(), rule:release(), grab:release(), request:cancel() and flowermenu:cancel() each answer the receiver they were called on, each still ends what it ended, the two idempotent ones answer the receiver a second time, and ov:destroy() still answers nil.
